title: Which Tasks Should You Delegate to AI Agents?
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: The weakest dimension determines the maximum level of autonomy you can safely grant.
quotes.why_it_matters: Core principle showing that delegation decisions depend on the worst-performing criterion, not average performance across dimensions

quotes.text: If you can't verify, you're not really delegating; you're gambling.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights why verifiability is a critical gate that prevents silent, costly failures that go undetected

quotes.text: A low feasibility score is often temporary. Models get better. Tools mature.
quotes.why_it_matters: Distinguishes between permanent unfitness and temporary unreadiness, enabling strategic reassessment as technology evolves
